_help: Tokens are NEVER written here: 'bot_token_env' / 'chat_id_env' are the NAMES of environment variables.
Run: python scripts/inspect_env.py   to list the variables your existing project already defines.
job_alerts=true  -> eligible job alerts go here (add as many destinations as you have).
resume_pdf=true  -> ONLY the three destinations named exactly '1 min', 'Fresher bot', '5 min and 30 min ago'.
If those three cannot be mapped unambiguously the resume PDFs are NOT sent (fail closed).
